title: The Last Light Square notice board, when read, gives the exact solution to Act 1 verbatim ('Three verses were cut for him — sunken shrine, old watchtower (east of the wood), the barrow's hall. Speak them and he sleeps.'), but the opening bearings at Village Gate never suggest visiting the village before the barrow, and the intro text points straight at 'the barrow on the hill.' I did not find the board until turn ~68, long after solving Act 1 by trial and error.
where: Last Light Square / 'read the notice board'
